description:
Software & Control Systems Engineers
Location: Bristol, Derby or Solihull
Rolls-Royce is seeking Software & Control Systems Engineers to support a range of current and future opportunities across our Defence business.
Our Software Systems teams are responsible for developing the control, monitoring and software solutions that enable safe, reliable and high-performing aerospace products. These teams work across the full engineering lifecycle, from requirements and architecture through to development, verification and deployment.
We are interested in hearing from engineers with experience in software development, controls engineering, systems integration and model-based design.
What you could be working on
Control & Monitoring Systems
Control Systems Design
Embedded Software Development
Systems Modelling & Simulation
Software Verification & Validation
Software Architecture
Systems Integration
Safety-Critical Software Development
What we're looking for
Software, Controls, Electronics or Engineering degree (or equivalent experience)
Experience developing software or control systems
Understanding of systems architecture and integration
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Experience within regulated or safety-critical environments is advantageous
Why join Rolls-Royce?
At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.
By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.
Apply
If you have experience in software engineering, controls engineering or systems development and would like to contribute to future Rolls-Royce Defence programmes, we would be pleased to hear from you.
Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.
Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.
To work for the Rolls-Royce Defence Early Life Cycle business an individual has to hold a Security Check clearance. Rolls-Royce will support the application for Security Clearance if you do not currently already have this in place.
Due to the nature of work the business conducts and the protection of certain assets we can only progress applications from individuals who are a UK national or, in MoD approved cases, a dual national.
As part of our selection process, candidates in certain locations may be asked to complete an online assessment, which can include cognitive and behavioural aptitude testing relevant to the role. If required, full instructions for the next steps will be provided.
Job Category
Software Systems

23 Sept 2026; 00:09

description:
Software Developer – Embedded Systems
Location: Bristol 3-4 days/week on customer site
Clearance: Must be eligible for DV clearance (British Citizen, UK residency last 10 years).
We are looking for a senior application developer who can take ownership of technically challenging software delivery in a secure, mission-focused environment. This role suits an engineer who is comfortable making design decisions, solving complex problems, and working directly with users to turn operational requirements into reliable software solutions
You will work primarily with Python, Vue, Electron, GitLab CI/CD, Ansible, Terraform/Terragrunt, and supporting platform technologies including MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis and RabbitMQ. Alongside application development, the role includes secure coding, infrastructure automation, deployment support, and occasional installation or configuration of hardware in controlled environments.
What You’ll Do
Lead the design and development of desktop, web, or service-based applications.
Architect and implement high quality Python code, application frameworks, APIs, and supporting automation.
Develop and maintain modern user interfaces and desktop/web applications using Vue and Electron.
Develop solutions that integrate data processing, UI/UX, automation, and system level components.
Create, maintain, and improve infrastructure as code using Ansible and Terraform/Terragrunt.
Lead testing, debugging, optimisation, and performance improvements.
Shape requirements, propose technical approaches, and influence project direction.
Support integration and deployment of software into secure operational environments.
Build and support CI/CD pipelines in GitLab to automate testing, packaging, deployment, and release activities.
Work with supporting platform components, including MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, RabbitMQ and related integration services.
Occasionally support installation, configuration, and commissioning of hardware in secure environments.
Engage directly with users to understand operational challenges and deliver effective solutions.
Produce high quality documentation and maintain traceable, peer reviewed git practices, aligned with repository governance policies.
Mentor junior developers and contribute to team knowledge sharing.
What You’ll Bring
Essential:
Extensive experience in software development for applications or tools.
Strong proficiency in Python and the ability to work across modern application frameworks and automation tooling.
Experience designing and delivering production quality applications.
Strong understanding of UI frameworks, APIs, data handling, system integration, and secure application design.
Confident working in Linux and/or MacOS development environments.
Ability to work flexibly across multiple programming languages and frameworks.
Proven ability to solve complex technical problems with creativity and rigour.
Ability to influence technical decisions and collaborate across teams.
Experience with testing frameworks, debugging tools, Git workflows, and CI/CD pipelines, ideally using GitLab.
Working knowledge of good industry practice for secure coding, application security, and security-conscious development lifecycles.
Experience with infrastructure as code, particularly Ansible and Terraform/Terragrunt.
Experience working with MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Redis, RabbitMQ, or similar data and messaging technologies.
Desirable:
Experience in secure or defence related environments.
Knowledge of cryptography, secure data handling, or secure system design.
Experience with web or desktop frameworks, particularly Vue and Electron, alongside Python web frameworks such as Flask, FastAPI, or Django.
Familiarity with containerisation, virtualisation, secure deployment practices, and operational support in controlled environments.
Practical experience installing, configuring, or troubleshooting hardware where software delivery depends on physical infrastructure.
Experience with distributed systems or message‑based architectures.
Education and Experience
Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field preferred.
Professional membership (BCS, IET) is a plus.
Why Leidos?
We’re a global technology company tackling the UK’s toughest national security challenges. Our Capability Development team is known for delivering bespoke, high-performance solutions in complex environments. We value people who are curious, self-directed, and eager to get their hands dirty with code.
What We Offer
Competitive Salary & Financial Rewards: Pension, share options, car leasing, free parking, cycle scheme.
Private Medical Insurance
33 Days Annual Leave (incl. public holidays), with buy/sell options.
Flexible Benefits: Life assurance, gym memberships, health plans.
Work-Life Balance: 37.5-hour week + up to 2 TOIL days per month.
Learning & Development: TechX Academy, unlimited e-learning, career mobility.
Flexi time working
If you want to work on real-world systems, close to the mission, and in a role where your code directly impacts outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.
At Leidos we are PASSIONATE about customer success, UNITED as a team and INSPIRED to make a difference. We offer meaningful and engaging careers, a collaborative culture, and support for your career goals, all while nurturing a healthy work-life balance.
We provide an employment package that attracts, develops and retains only the best in talent.
Commitment to Diversity:
We welcome applications from every part of the community and are committed to a truly diverse and inclusive culture. We foster a sense of belonging, welcoming all perspectives and contributions, and providing equal access to opportunities and resources for everyone. If you have a disability or need any reasonable adjustments during the application and selection stages please let us know, and we will respond in a way that best fits your needs.
Who We Are:
Leidos UK & EUROPE – we work to make the world safer, healthier, and more efficient through technology, engineering and science.
Leidos is a growing company delivering innovative technology and solutions focused on safeguarding critical capabilities and transformation in frontline services, our work in the United Kingdom includes addressing some of the most complex problems in defence, healthcare, government, safety and security, and transportation.
What Makes Us Different:
Purpose: you can use your passion and abilities at Leidos to keep the people you care about safe. We are at the forefront of machine learning, AI, cyber security and solutions. Using your skills in the technology frontline by helping to build a safer world. You can inspire change.
Collaboration: having flexibility to do your job is one of our core benefits, enabling you to become part of our extraordinary team. We have been empowering our people to work flexibly for years. Whether you work from home, the office or on customer sites, we will give you the digital tools and the flexibility to work smarter and align your needs and ours.
People: Leidos empowers people from every background to be themselves and gives you the tools to learn new skills by enabling growth whilst developing. We believe that extraordinary people need opportunities to grow, to be inspired and to inspire others. At Leidos, we invest in technical academies, career rotations and a career development plans that enhance your future. #INTNSD
If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.
Original Posting:
For U.S. Positions: While subject to change based on business needs, Leidos reasonably anticipates that this job requisition will remain open for at least 3 days with an anticipated close date of no earlier than 3 days after the original posting date as listed above.
Pay Range:
£61,500.00-£78,800.00
The Leidos pay range for this job level is a general guideline only and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. Additional factors considered in extending an offer include (but are not limited to) responsibilities of the job, education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity, alignment with market data, applicable bargaining agreement (if any), or other law.
About Leidos
Leidos is an industry and technology leader serving government and commercial customers with smarter, more efficient digital and mission innovations. Headquartered in Reston, Virginia, with 47,000 global employees, Leidos reported annual revenues of approximately $16.7 billion for the fiscal year ended January 3, 2025. For more information, visit www.Leidos.com.
Pay and Benefits
Pay and benefits are fundamental to any career decision. That's why we craft compensation packages that reflect the importance of the work we do for our customers. Employment benefits include competitive compensation, Health and Wellness programs, Income Protection, Paid Leave and Retirement. More details are available at www.leidos.com/careers/pay-benefits.
Securing Your Data
Beware of fake employment opportunities using Leidos’ name. Leidos will never ask you to provide payment-related information during any part of the employment application process (i.e., ask you for money), nor will Leidos ever advance money as part of the hiring process (i.e., send you a check or money order before doing any work). Further, Leidos will only communicate with you through emails that are generated by the Leidos.com automated system – never from free commercial services (e.g., Gmail, Yahoo, Hotmail) or via WhatsApp, Telegram, etc. If you received an email purporting to be from Leidos that asks for payment-related information or any other personal information (e.g., about you or your previous employer), and you are concerned about its legitimacy, please make us aware immediately by emailing us at LeidosCareersFraud@leidos.com.
If you believe you are the victim of a scam, contact your local law enforcement and report the incident to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission.
Commitment to Non-Discrimination
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, ethnicity, age, national origin, citizenship, religion, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, pregnancy, family structure, marital status, ancestry, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. description:
We are looking for a Lead Platform Engineer to join our AI Platform Enablement team and help build, operate and continuously improve our orchestration and developer experience solutions. This hands-on role will focus on creating secure, automated and repeatable experiences that help engineering teams onboard workloads and make effective use of approved developer tooling.
Job Type: Permanent
Location: Hybrid: based at any of our UK offices Birmingham, London, Telford, Edinburgh with time spent working in the office and at home
Flexible working: All roles are open to part-time, job-share and other types of flexibility. We will discuss what is important to you and balancing this with business requirements during the recruitment process. You can read more about flexible working here.
Closing Date: 15th October
Salary and benefits: from £75,000 (dependant upon experience) plus an indicative bonus range of 16-32%, private medical cover, 38 days annual leave, excellent pension, 12x salary life assurance, career breaks, income protection, 3x volunteering days and much more.
Who are we?
We're Standard Life, a retirement specialist focused entirely on retirement savings and income. We champion the belief that everyone's journey to and through retirement can be better, and for more than 200 years, we've been helping our customers plan and prepare for their financial futures.
Life today is increasingly complicated, uncertain and unpredictable. People move through different careers, face unexpected moments and navigate important choices. We offer our colleagues flexibility, trust and benefits that work for whatever life brings. In return we expect curiosity, connection, accountability and high standards. We make room for what matters - so you can bring your best, every day.
The role
This senior, hands-on role will shape and operate the orchestration and developer platform solutions supporting our Pensions & Savings technology services. You will lead delivery across developer tooling, automation and reusable workflows-including GitHub, GitHub Copilot, developer portals, artefact and container management, observability and cloud integration-while partnering across application, architecture, security, risk and technology teams to provide secure, governed and scalable developer experiences.
What you will do
Build, operate and continuously improve secure, reliable and reusable internal developer platform capabilities for Pensions & Savings.
Create and evolve golden paths and automated onboarding journeys that help engineering teams onboard new and existing workloads, adopt approved developer tooling and deliver software consistently.
Administer and improve GitHub and GitHub Copilot capabilities, including organisation, team and repository onboarding, access, policies, rulesets and reusable workflows.
Develop robust platform automation using appropriate combinations of GitHub Actions, APIs, infrastructure as code and scripting, replacing manual or inconsistent processes wherever practical.
Support secure artefact and container management, including integration with build and delivery workflows and appropriate controls for access, provenance, retention and vulnerability management.
Contribute to developer portal and self-service capabilities that improve discoverability, documentation, service ownership and access to standard platform journeys.
Embed security, identity, governance, compliance and observability into platform services and onboarding processes, while maintaining the operational health and auditability of enterprise developer tooling.
Partner with application, product, architecture, security, risk and operations teams to resolve complex issues, support effective use of tools such as Jira and Confluence across the software development lifecycle, and improve platform capabilities through documentation, enablement and feedback.
What are we looking for?
Strong hands-on experience in platform engineering, DevOps or developer tooling, with a track record of creating reliable automation, reusable workflows and self-service capabilities.
Practical experience with GitHub and modern software delivery practices, including repositories, access controls, CI/CD and secure development workflows.
A security-first approach to operating enterprise tooling, with a sound understanding of identity and access management, privileged administration, secrets, platform policies and auditability.
Familiarity with internal developer platforms, developer portals and golden-path approaches, together with a practical understanding of cloud environments and related capabilities such as artefact and container management, observability, AI-enabled developer tooling, Jira and Confluence.
The ability to take ownership of complex technical work, make and explain sound engineering decisions, and collaborate effectively with application, architecture, security, risk and operations teams.
How will we measure success?
Secure, reliable and supportable internal developer platform services that meet agreed operational, security and compliance expectations.
Faster, safer and more repeatable workload onboarding through effective golden paths, reusable workflows and automated controls.
Growing adoption of approved developer tooling and self-service capabilities, with reduced developer friction and less reliance on manual intervention.
Improved operational outcomes through effective observability, automation, clear service ownership and the reduction of recurring platform and onboarding issues.
Transparent and responsible consumption of developer tooling and platform services, with decisions balancing developer value, performance, risk and cost.
Stronger platform engineering capability through sound technical leadership, clear documentation, effective enablement and knowledge sharing.
We want to hire the whole version of you.
We are committed to ensuring that everyone feels accepted and welcome applicants from all backgrounds. If your experience looks different from what we've advertised and you believe that you can bring value to the role, we'd love to hear from you.
If you require any adjustments to the recruitment process, please let us know so we can help you to be at your best.
We're reviewing applications as they come in, so apply early to avoid missing out. #LI-GJ1

description:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.
We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €110M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.
About The Role
Our hubs are in Berlin, London and Tallinn, but we are open to hire remotely from Europe and United Kingdom.
What You’ll Do
Make an impact in a true product team with a large ownership scope.
Work with cutting-edge technologies (Go is the primary language; it’s okay if you’re willing to switch from another language) without a legacy codebase.
Work on improving the reliability of our API.
Deliver fast and often. We embrace an agile methodology with a retrospective and demo at the end of the two-week cycle.
Design, build and own event-driven, fault-tolerant, horizontally scalable distributed systems using a Microservice architecture powered by Docker, Kubernetes, Kafka and PostgreSQL.
It’s Great If You Have
Experience with Investment products or the Fintech domain, in general.
Experience in event-driven architectures, event streaming, and event sourcing systems.
Experience with operating services in a decoupled, event-driven system, leveraging modern observability tooling (e.g. monitoring and tracing).
You’re likely to be successful in this role if:
You're excited about fintech and building the financial infrastructure of tomorrow.
You work with the customer in mind.
You are a true team player and feel energized in diverse teams.
You're hungry to learn and eager to grow quickly.
How We Upvest In You
Best-in-class AI tools: Every Upvenger has €20,000 per year to spend on the best AI tools available — so you're always working with the most powerful models and tooling on the market.
Impact-driven work: We’re building the infrastructure that will power the future of investing in Europe. It’s complex, ambitious, and meaningful. You’ll work with modern technologies and create something entirely new. No legacy systems, no limits.
Wellbeing: Recharge with 30 days of annual leave and maintain a healthy lifestyle with sports benefits. Access confidential professional coaching and enjoy the flexibility to work remotely abroad for up to 183 days a year. Recharge with UpRest, a one-month fully paid sabbatical after every 4 years of working at Upvest.
Development: Growth is in our DNA. Each Upvenger has access to a personal development budget and the freedom to decide how to use it.
Flexible work environment: Work from any of our hubs in Berlin, London or Tallinn hybrid or remotely across Europe, depending on the role. We give you the choice and budget to work where you’re most comfortable and productive, either at home or in the office. You choose.
Compensation and equity: We believe that all Upvengers contribute to our success and deserve a competitive, above-market salary and a participation in our employee equity program.
Team celebrations: Participate in company-wide events, such as UpFest, dinners, offsites and our Holiday party, to connect with colleagues and celebrate our achievements.
Inclusion: We’re committed to a culture where everyone belongs and thrives. Our Employee Resources Groups foster inclusion and connection, like Upfem for our female Upvengers, or UpVergent supporting neurodivergent Upvengers and allies.
Our Values
Make it easy for others. We simplify the complex and act with the best intentions
Own the outcome. We are proactive, fast and confident to get the job done, valuing progress over perfection.
Rise to the challenge. We aim high and push the boundaries. We stay curious, learn and celebrate our wins together.
Tell the story. We start with the Why to align on purpose. We are transparent and share knowledge to empower and inspire others.
Upvest is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

description:
Are you passionate about building secure, next-generation technology that protects people and institutions at scale? Join a team of innovators at JPMorganChase where your engineering expertise directly shapes how millions of customers and institutions authenticate and access critical financial services. Here, you'll work on mission-critical identity and access management solutions that sit at the intersection of security, innovation, and customer experience — with the resources and global reach to make a real impact.
As a Software Engineer III at JPMorganChase within the Commercial & Investment Bank Identity Engineering team, you will design, build, and modernize authentication and authorization platforms that serve some of the world's most important corporations, governments, and institutions. You'll collaborate with a global network of technologists to deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality solutions across channels and domains. This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge authentication technologies while contributing to a firm entrusted with holding trillions in assets across more than 100 countries
Job Responsibilities
Design and develop secure authentication and authorization solutions across customer-facing channels and enterprise platforms
Modernize identity and access management systems, including authentication and authorization frameworks aligned to open standards
Evaluate and prototype internal and vendor solutions for user authentication, including anti-fraud and biometric capabilities
Integrate APIs and SDKs for both niche authentication solutions and open standards such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect, and SAML
Collaborate with cross-functional and globally distributed engineering teams to deliver high-quality, business-valued outcomes
Drive quality and efficiency across the software development lifecycle through strong engineering practices and code standards
Contribute to technical direction by setting and modeling high standards for design, development, and testing
Leverages enterprise-authorized AI coding assist tools within the work environment to improve code quality, delivery speed, and productivity (e.g., code generation/refactoring, unit test creation, documentation), while validating outputs through peer review, automated testing, and secure coding standards
Applies knowledge of tools within the Software Development Life Cycle toolchain, including enterprise-authorized AI-assisted development and automation capabilities, to improve the value realized by automations
Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Formal training or certification on software engineering concepts and proficient applied experience
Proficiency in one or more general-purpose programming languages, with strong preference for Java
Experience with application and data architecture principles, including design patterns and business process integration
Familiarity with cloud-native development on platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform
Ability to work collaboratively across local and global teams, building relationships to achieve shared goals
Flexibility to work across multiple technology stacks and application environments
Hands-on experience using enterprise-authorized AI-assisted software development tools within the work environment (e.g., for coding, testing, troubleshooting, or documentation) with demonstrated ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated outputs
Understanding of responsible AI use in engineering workflows, including data sensitivity considerations, secure handling of inputs/outputs, and adherence to resiliency and security expectations
Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills
Experience with modern authentication protocols and standards such as OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SAML, or federated identity solutions
Exposure to anti-fraud technologies or biometric authentication integrations within customer-facing applications
Experience working in regulated financial services or similarly complex enterprise environments
Familiarity with identity and access management platforms or vendor solutions
Knowledge of API security best practices and SDK integration patterns
ABOUT US
J.P. Morgan is a global leader in financial services, providing strategic advice and products to the world's most prominent corporations, governments, wealthy individuals and institutional investors. Our first-class business in a first-class way approach to serving clients drives everything we do. We strive to build trusted, long-term partnerships to help our clients achieve their business objectives.
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
About The Team
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

We’re looking for a Lead Software Engineer with a path to CTO to join our founding team in Canary Wharf. You’ll lead technical direction across our platform, mentor a growing engineering team and build AI-powered products using Laravel, React, Python and AWS.
Connectivity matters.
We’re BroadbandUK. We help millions of people each year make better broadband decisions because fast, reliable internet improves everyday life.
We’ve already launched the UK’s first address-level price comparison service, built a speed test used by over a million people, and partnered with organisations like Openreach, Currys and The Telegraph.
But we’re just getting started.
BroadbandUK is a high-growth, revenue-generating startup entering an exciting new phase.
One of our next major challenges is improving how broadband information is represented when people move home. Connectivity is an increasingly important characteristic of a property, yet useful broadband information is often limited or notably absent from property listings.
We’re working with the industry to help make broadband information a standard part of every property listing and define the data structures that will make this possible.
To achieve this, we are transitioning into an AI-first company, using large language models and automated workflows to transform how we solve connectivity challenges.
This is a rare opportunity to help build a company from the ground up and become a household name that touches the lives of millions.
Be part of a close-knit, ambitious team where you’ll learn quickly and work on challenges that matter, and we hope you’ll enjoy the journey as much as we do.
What you’ll do
As Lead Software Engineer, you’ll play a crucial role in shaping the future of BroadbandUK. You’ll work directly with the CEO and co-founders to:
Mentor a growing team of engineers, guiding graduates and interns as they level up their skills.
Shape the architecture and technical direction of our products, balancing scalability with speed of delivery.
Design and integrate AI models and algorithms that unlock insights from national connectivity data to tackle real-world challenges.
Leverage unique datasets from Ofcom, Openreach, independent networks and ISPs to uncover problems that directly impact how the UK connects.
Develop retrieval and agentic systems, combining LLMs with vector search and automation to push the boundaries of how AI can be applied to connectivity challenges.
Our stack
Backend: PHP (Laravel), Python (for AI/ML workflows)
Frontend: React, Next.js (preferred), with flexibility for other modern frameworks
Infrastructure: AWS (including Lambda, S3, DynamoDB), DigitalOcean
Data: MySQL, Redis, NoSQL stores
Dev tools: GitHub, CI/CD, Docker
AI & Automation: LLM APIs, vector databases, agentic workflow tools, n8n, Claude Code, Cursor
Who we’re looking for
We’re looking for a Lead Software Engineer with a path to CTO to join our founding team and help shape the future of connectivity in the UK.
5+ years of software engineering experience, with a strong track record of building, shipping and scaling real-world products.
Strong leadership skills: guiding teams and setting technical direction.
An ownership mindset: you thrive in startup environments and like solving real problems and learning fast.
Proven impact: you’ve built and scaled products, led projects that made a difference, contributed to open-source, or delivered results that truly moved the needle.
Practical AI experience: some experience building with LLMs, retrieval, agents or related technologies is strongly preferred.
We know no one ticks every box, but proven experience in leading engineering teams and building and scaling real-world products is essential.
Why you’ll love it here
Impact from day one: your work goes live quickly and matters immediately.
Big challenges, close-knit team: complex, national-scale connectivity challenges that stretch you and help you grow fast.
Freedom to innovate: we are independent and privately funded, with focus over noise.
Growth and mentorship: a genuine path to senior leadership, working closely with the founders.
Let’s build the future of connectivity together.
BroadbandUK is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
Apply Now

Engineer or PLC Programmer with strong hands-on experience across

machine performance and sharing your technical knowledge with
other engineers?

with specialist automated manufacturing equipment, taking
ownership of complex software and controls issues while helping

manufacturing machinery.

identifying faults, improving existing software and implementing

throughput.

directly with production machinery, troubleshoot complex
automation issues and collaborate closely with other engineers to
ensure equipment performs effectively.

role in mentoring and developing junior and mid-level engineers,

capability across the department.

* Develop and support HMI systems

systems, RFID and inverters
* Diagnose and resolve complex software and automation faults
* Improve existing machine software to increase reliability,
availability and throughput
* Identify opportunities to improve automated manufacturing
processes
* Take ownership of complex technical problems from initial
diagnosis through to resolution

machine downtime

automation systems

the team

already has a strong level of automation and controls expertise.
You'll need:
* Proven experience within Automation, Controls or Production
Support Engineering
* Strong practical experience programming PLCs
* Experience with Mitsubishi iQ-R or closely equivalent PLC
systems
* Practical experience programming and fault finding industrial
robots
* Mitsubishi robot experience or experience with comparable
robotic platforms
* Experience programming HMI systems
* Hands-on experience with industrial vision systems
* Keyence, Asyril or equivalent vision system experience
* Strong understanding of software programming methodologies
* Excellent and methodical fault-finding skills
* Ability to independently diagnose and resolve complex
automation problems
* Confidence modifying and improving existing machine software
* Experience training, mentoring or developing other engineers
Technical environment
You'll be working with technologies including:
* Mitsubishi iQ-R PLCs
* Mitsubishi Robots
* Keyence Vision Systems
* Asyril Vision & Flexible Feeding Systems
* HMIs
* Servo systems
* RFID
* Inverters
* Bespoke automated manufacturing machinery
Direct experience with every specific manufacturer isn't
essential, but you'll need strong hands-on experience with these
technologies or closely equivalent industrial automation systems.
About you
You're an experienced automation professional who can confidently
take ownership of technically challenging problems rather than
relying on fixed solutions.
You'll be:
* An excellent technical problem solver
* Methodical when fault finding
* Comfortable taking ownership and working independently
* Collaborative and willing to share your expertise
* A confident technical mentor
* Patient when developing less experienced engineers
* Highly detail-focused
* Interested in improving machine performance rather than simply
maintaining the status quo
Because the products manufactured are extremely small and
precision-focused, attention to detail is essential.
Why join?
This is an excellent opportunity to join a business investing
significantly in automation, technology and advanced
manufacturing.
You'll work in an engineering environment where automation is
central to future growth, giving you the opportunity to influence
machine performance, improve production capability and help
develop the next generation of automation engineers.
While ongoing training and development will be available, this is
a genuine senior-level opportunity for someone who can bring
significant automation expertise from day one.

* 25 days holiday plus bank holidays
* Additional 3 days off over the festive period
